Interactions API reached GA on June 22, 2026 as Google's primary API for Gemini models and agents — stable schema, Managed Agents (Antigravity default, custom agents with instructions/skills/data sources, single-call remote Linux sandbox), background execution (background=True), Google Search + Google Maps + custom functions mixed in one request, tool results returning images alongside text, Deep Research upgrades (speed-vs-depth variants, collaborative planning, native charts/infographics, multimodal grounding with images/PDFs/audio), media generation (Nano Banana 2 image with Google Image Search grounding, Lyria 3 music, multi-speaker TTS), and the new 'Steps' schema replacing roles (each action — user_input, thought, function_call, model_output — is its own typed step). Now the default in AI Studio, Gemini API, and all documentation; ecosystem partners LiteLLM, Eigent, and Agno have launched Interactions API integrations. Gemini 3.5 Flash gained native Computer Use (June 25, 2026) — 78.4 on OSWorld, ahead of Gemini 3 Flash (65.1) and GPT-5.4 mini (72.1); trails GPT-5.5 (78.7) and Opus 4.8 (83.4). Available via Gemini API and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform with prompt-injection safeguards. Gemini 3.5 Pro GA pushed from June to July 2026 (June 23 announcement) to incorporate early-tester feedback — 2M-token context and Deep Think reasoning mode still planned. Google DeepMind + A24 research partnership announced June 22, 2026 for creator-facing AI tooling.

OpenAI.name: OpenAI Platform
OpenAI.description: Responses API with GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.5 Pro, GPT Image 2 (ChatGPT Images 2.0, April 21, 2026), Realtime 2 (gpt-realtime-2, gpt-realtime-translate, gpt-realtime-whisper May 7, 2026). Agent tooling, WebSocket execution mode. Batch and Flex pricing at half standard rate. Now on AWS Bedrock (June 1, 2026) and Oracle Cloud (June 10, 2026). Ona acquisition announced June 11, 2026 to expand Codex into secure customer-controlled cloud execution. Daybreak vision (security models + Codex Security) coming to AWS. OpenAI Partner Network (June 14, 2026, $150M) supports partner-built solutions with Codex specializations. Daybreak / GPT-5.5-Cyber full release (June 22, 2026) for security workloads — GPT-5.5-Cyber is the most capable OpenAI cyber model (85.6% CyberGym vs 81.8% for stock GPT-5.5, ~26% → ~40% on ExploitGym), shipping alongside the Codex Security plugin and the Daybreak Cyber Partner Program. Patch the Planet (June 22, 2026) pairs OpenAI's Codex Security with Trail of Bits engineers to triage and patch open-source vulnerabilities across maintainer-stretched projects; OpenAI committed ChatGPT Pro, conditional Codex access, and API credits to participating maintainers. GPT-5.5-Cyber access is gated to vetted defenders through the Trusted Access for Cyber program; standard GPT-5.5 with Trusted Access is available to other approved users. Daybreak Cyber Partner Program launch partners: Accenture, Cisco, CrowdStrike, IBM, Okta, Palo Alto Networks, Wiz. OpenAI Jalapeño custom inference chip unveiled June 24, 2026 in collaboration with Broadcom — OpenAI's first ground-up-designed AI silicon, ~216GB HBM3E, ~7.1-7.4 TB/s bandwidth, FP4 throughput; late-2026 production target for ChatGPT, Codex, and API inference. Codex Remote reached GA June 25, 2026 with authenticated one-to-one QR pairing; opens phone-based control of long-running coding sessions to all paid ChatGPT subscribers (Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, Education).

Anthropic.name: Claude API
Anthropic.description: Claude Fable 5 (Mythos-class, June 9, 2026, $10/$50 per 1M tokens, 1M context) on `claude-fable-5` — SUSPENDED June 12–June 30, 2026 by US export control directive — REDEPLOYED July 1, 2026 after US export controls lifted (new safety classifier blocks the Amazon-reported technique in 99%+ cases) over alleged narrow jailbreak, disabled for all customers. Anthropic given only 90 minutes notice; subsequent reports suggest groups linked to the Chinese government may have accessed the model. Trump administration cited Anthropic's 'recklessness' in responding to initial concerns (June 15). Anthropic staff including cofounder Tom Brown and policy chief Sarah Heck in talks with Commerce Secretary Lutnick and Cyber Director Cairncross (June 13-17, 2026) to lift the order; no timeline yet. Opus 4.8, Sonnet 4.6, and Haiku 4.5 remain available. Computer use, long-context developer platform, Advisor strategy, Memory, MCP tunnels, dreaming/outcomes/multiagent orchestration. Claude Platform on AWS GA (May 11, 2026). ant CLI for Claude API with YAML versioning and Claude Code integration (June 2026). Claude Code Analytics API. Dynamic workflows GA in Claude Code (June 11, 2026) and managed agents now run on schedules with vault-stored env vars (June 11, 2026). June 15, 2026: legacy `claude-opus-4-20250514` and `claude-sonnet-4-20250514` retired — requests now fail; next: `claude-opus-4-1-20250805` retires August 5, 2026. Z.ai positioned GLM-5.2 (June 16, MIT license) as a direct open-weight beneficiary of the Fable 5 suspension. Claude Tag (Slack-native AI teammate) launched June 23, 2026 for Claude Enterprise / Team — persistent channel-scoped Claude instance with optional ambient mode for proactive follow-ups; single @Claude identity per org; 30-day migration from 'Claude in Slack' (powered by Claude Opus 4.8). Mythos 5 cleared by Commerce Department on June 26, 2026 for ~100 pre-approved US cyber-defender and infrastructure-provider organizations after two-week negotiation; broader access pending formal process. Claude Code v2.1.190 (June 24, 2026) ships strings signaling Fable 5 weekly-limit return to subscriptions.

Microsoft.name: Azure AI Foundry
Microsoft.description: Unified model, agent, eval, and deployment platform on Azure. Multi-model hub, inference profiles, global cross-region deployment. GPT-5.5 Instant, GPT-5.5 Thinking, and MAI-Thinking-1 (private preview, June 2, 2026) available. Fireworks AI GA on Foundry. Mistral Medium 3.5 added to Foundry model catalog (May 28, 2026) with in-region data control and admin governance. Open access to weights for the MAI family for the first time, on OpenRouter/Fireworks/Baseten. Microsoft and Mayo Clinic co-creating frontier healthcare AI model.

Amazon.name: Amazon Quick Suite
Amazon.description: AI agent teammates for research, business insights, and automation. Answer questions and turn answers into actions across enterprise workflows.

Meta.name: Meta Model API
Meta.description: Meta's first paid developer API for its own frontier model (public preview launched July 9, 2026 alongside Muse Spark 1.1). $1.25/M input, $4.25/M output (reasoning tokens billed at output rate) — Meta's first commercial revenue from its own models and a deliberate break from the open-weight Llama playbook. Drop-in OpenAI-compatible (Chat Completions and Responses) and Anthropic-compatible (Messages) endpoints over one backend; base URL api.meta.ai/v1, model id muse-spark-1.1. US-only public preview at launch with no international timeline; new accounts get $20 free credits; EU-based developers excluded. Not listed on third-party marketplaces (OpenRouter etc.) — distribution confined to Meta's developer portal. Also exposes Meta's own first paid coding-tier pricing — lower than Anthropic Claude Haiku 4.5 / OpenAI GPT-5.6 Luna. Early launch partners: Replit, Cline, Box, OpenCode (built-in Meta provider). Meta swapped its content moderation and support stack to Muse Spark (June 25, 2026) — 13% fewer errors than human reviewers, 10% more violations caught vs prior Google Gemini pipeline.

DeepSeek.name: DeepSeek API
DeepSeek.description: Low-cost API access to DeepSeek V4 (Pro: $0.435/$0.87, Flash: $0.14/$0.28 per 1M tokens - 75% discount made permanent May 23, 2026). 1M context, 384K max output, reasoning modes, multimodal image recognition. OpenAI and Anthropic compatible formats. Hybrid Attention combining CSA and HCA. Built on Huawei Ascend 950PR. June 14, 2026: official GitHub Copilot integration page documents a VS Code extension that adds DeepSeek V4 Pro and Flash to Copilot Chat with agent mode, tool calling, skills, MCP, and an optional vision proxy path. June 15, 2026: official Hermes Agent integration page documents a curl install flow, Quick Setup with DeepSeek as the provider, api.deepseek.com as base URL, and deepseek-v4-pro as the default model. DeepSeek V4 Flash latency improved 40% (1.6s → 973ms) per AILatency June 13, 2026. DeepSeek closed first external funding round at $7.4B / $50B+ valuation on June 16, 2026.

Mistral.name: La Plateforme
Mistral.description: Mistral developer platform for chat, OCR, embeddings, agents, and code. Medium 3.5 default with reasoning_effort parameter. Vibe CLI with remote cloud sandboxes (May 5, 2026). Voxtral TTS with zero-shot voice cloning. Mistral Medium 3.5 added to Microsoft Copilot Studio model lineup (May 28, 2026) with EU in-region data control and admin governance — in early release environments. New Mistral Vibe extension for VS Code. Code Mode (May 28, 2026) launches remote coding agents from the Vibe web surface with GitHub integration, parallel sessions, and Slack triggers (June). Mistral in early talks to raise €3B at €20B valuation, plans 1GW compute by 2030. Mistral Forge (enterprise custom model training on proprietary data — codebases, compliance policies, operational docs — supporting dense and MoE with pre/post-training + RL) and Mistral AI Studio (production deployment platform: Observability, Agent Runtime on Temporal, AI Registry for asset versioning) launched June 18, 2026. OCR 4 (June 23, 2026) adds document intelligence — bounding boxes, block-type labels, per-word confidence scores — 170 languages, 85.20 OlmOCRBench / 93.07 OmniDocBench / 72% blind win rate; $4 per 1,000 pages ($2 batch). Integrated into Mistral Search Toolkit (public preview).

NVIDIA.name: NVIDIA Build
NVIDIA.description: NIM-backed API catalog and deployment platform for enterprise AI services. NIM 2.0 with custom model support. Nemotron 3 Ultra NIM 2.0.5 (June 4, 2026, 550B-A55B, NVFP4). NVIDIA Blackwell leads the first Agentic AI Infrastructure Benchmark (June 12, 2026). Cosmos, Isaac models available. Nemotron 3 Ultra, Nemotron 3.5 ASR, Nemotron 3.5 Content Safety on Microsoft Foundry (June 2, 2026).

Cloudflare.name: Workers AI
Cloudflare.description: Serverless GPU inference on Cloudflare's global network. 100+ open-source models (Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Stable Diffusion, Whisper). 200+ cities, pay-per-use pricing, LoRA fine-tuning support.

Alibaba.name: Model Studio
Alibaba.description: Alibaba Cloud developer platform for Qwen models and agent apps. Qwen 3.7-Max (May 26, 2026, Singapore Qwen Conference) and Qwen3.7-Plus (June 2, 2026, multimodal, #5 on Vision Arena, $0.40/$2.40 per 1M tokens) available via API. Qwen Cloud (June 3, 2026) is a new AI-native cloud platform with Skills portal for agents, CLI for workflows, and Model Studio CLI; brings together Qwen models, open-source models, and third-party offerings for text/vision/audio/image/video/embedding tasks. Model Studio CLI (June 8, 2026) is open-source and gives agents access to 150+ multimodal models (Qwen, HappyHorse, Wan, DeepSeek, Kimi) with one terminal command.

HuggingFace.name: Inference API
HuggingFace.description: Hosted API layer for open models, endpoints, and serverless inference. Inference API 3.0 with edge deployment (10x latency), Inference Pro with auto-scaling.

MiniMax.name: MiniMax Platform
MiniMax.description: MiniMax API platform for text (M3 launched June 1, 2026; M2.7, M2.5), speech (Speech 2.8), video (Hailuo 2.3), and music (Music 2.6) models. M3-highspeed variant available with MSA 1M context. June 17, 2026: MiniMax Realtime API GA with HTTP and WebSocket interfaces — end-to-end real-time multimodal processing, supports free choice of text or voice input and text or voice output, hyper-personalized emotional voice library, significantly reduced end-to-end latency for enterprise collaboration, social interactions, live streaming, and gaming. Token plans $20/$50/$120/mo.

Cohere.name: Cohere API
Cohere.description: Developer platform for Command A+ (May 21, 2026, Apache 2.0) with embeddings, rerank, and agent toolkits. Self-host on 2x H100 or single Blackwell. North enterprise API with role-based access, audit logs, and data residency.

Moonshot.name: Moonshot API
Moonshot.description: Kimi K2.7-Code (June 12, 2026, Modified MIT, $0.95/$4.00 per 1M tokens, 1T total/32B active MoE, 256K context, +21.8% on Kimi Code Bench v2 vs K2.6) plus K2.6, K2.5 endpoints. OpenAI-compatible REST API with long-context, function calling, vision, and agent-mode tools. K2.7-Code targets long-horizon software engineering with 30% fewer reasoning tokens. Token-based pricing on Moonshot Platform.

Apple.name: Foundation Models Framework
Apple.description: Apple's native Swift framework (announced WWDC26, June 1, 2026) giving apps direct access to the on-device Apple Foundation Models that power Apple Intelligence. Multimodal prompts (text + images), Vision framework tool calls (OCR, barcode) executed on-device, Dynamic Profiles to swap models/tools/instructions mid-session, Language Model protocol for plugging in third-party providers (Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, any conforming endpoint). Cloud access to next-gen Apple Foundation Models via Private Cloud Compute is free for App Store Small Business Program apps with under 2M first-time downloads. Ships with the new Evaluations framework for testing AI features under dynamic conditions, App Intents framework upgrades (View Annotations API for on-screen awareness, App Intents Testing framework), and a reimagined Image Playground API (new photorealistic generative model on Private Cloud Compute, text/touch refinement, landscape/portrait dimensions).

Sakana.name: Sakana Fugu
Sakana.description: Sakana AI's learned multi-agent orchestration model (launched June 22, 2026, Tokyo). Sakana Fugu routes tasks across a swappable pool of frontier LLMs (Claude, GPT, Gemini) behind a single OpenAI-compatible API and claims parity with Claude Fable 5 / Mythos Preview on SWE-Bench Pro and Terminal-Bench. Sakana Fugu Ultra adds deeper reasoning and tool-use budget control. Pricing ~$5/$30 per 1M tokens. Also distributed via OpenRouter. Positioned as 'frontier capability without export-control risk' for markets locked out of Mythos-class Western models — Fable 5 redeployed globally July 1, 2026 after US export controls lifted, so this positioning now applies only to the more restricted Mythos 5 access (limited to ~100 pre-approved US cyber-defender orgs). Available to enterprise customers via API and on the Sakana AI Playground.

Runway Dev.name: Runway Dev
Runway Dev.description: Runway's enterprise AI media platform for developers (launched July 8, 2026) — single API integrating Runway's frontier models (Gen-4.5, Aleph 2.0, Act-Two) alongside best-in-class third-party models (Seedance 2.0, GPT Image 2, ElevenLabs) with day-zero availability for new model releases. Outcomes-based Recipes for high-volume creative generations (ads, ecommerce product visuals, social cutdowns); customizable Workflow endpoints to compose multi-model pipelines; interactive real-time Characters API for agent personalities. Already used by Adobe, ElevenLabs, Shutterstock, Figma Weave, Gamma, Silverside at millions of generations scale. Enterprise-ready with zero-data retention, contractual no-train guarantees, and procurement-grade security controls (SOC 2, GDPR). Single billing and observability across every model; swap models by changing one line of code. Available now at dev.runwayml.com.

SpaceXAI.name: xAI API
SpaceXAI.description: Developer access to Grok 4.3 ($1.25/$2.50 per 1M tokens) and grok-4.20 (2M context). Custom Voices TTS ($4.20/1M chars), Voice Agent API ($3/hr). grok-imagine-image-quality for image generation. grok-imagine-video-1.5-preview (June 3, 2026, 720p image-to-video, #1 Artificial Analysis Video Arena Image-to-Video at Elo 1404, 15-second clips) and Grok Imagine Video 1.5 GA (June 16, 2026). grok-build-0.1 for terminal coding workflows. Composer 2.5 in Grok Build (June 1, 2026). Responses API with tool calling (May 22, 2026). Grok 5 in training on Colossus 2 (1.5GW). Grok V9-Medium (1.5T params, Cursor-trained coding model) finished training May 25, 2026; public release expected mid-June 2026 with pricing TBD. Grok Build Plugin Marketplace (June 11, 2026) for skills, slash commands, agents, hooks, MCP servers, and LSPs from MongoDB, Vercel, Sentry, Chrome DevTools, Cloudflare, Superpowers. Voice API default for Vapi (June 3, 2026). Gopuff Go and eToro Tori agent integrations. June 15, 2026: multi-session coding manager (manage many coding sessions at once from Grok Build). Grok Build /goal command launched June 22, 2026 — long-running autonomous tasks with sub-agents implementing and verifying a single user-defined goal (significant repositioning of Grok Build as a multi-step agent platform). Firecrawl plugin (June 23, 2026) and MongoDB plugin (June 24, 2026) added to the Grok Build Plugin Marketplace. Grok + Interactive Brokers integration launched June 22, 2026 — query portfolio data, research investments, analyze positions using AI; trade execution requires explicit user approval. Grok 5 public release by June 30, 2026 now priced at 2.9-7% on prediction markets (Polymarket, Kalshi). Grok 4.5 API (launched July 8, 2026) now the default: $2 input / $6 output per 1M tokens, with reasoning effort Low/Medium/High, Responses API and Chat Completions endpoints, function calling, web/X search, and code execution. Trained in SpaceXAI Memphis data centers. EU availability delayed — 'available later this month'.

OpenRouter-Transcription.name: OpenRouter Transcription API
OpenRouter-Transcription.description: OpenRouter's dedicated transcription endpoint (launched July 22, 2026) — `POST /api/v1/audio/transcriptions` accepts base64 audio and returns JSON text plus a usage object, using the same API key as chat. Same OpenAI-compatible contract carries across every modality on the platform thanks to the single base URL `/api/v1`. Bundled routing controls (provider order, automatic failover, data-collection policy, cost/latency sort) work identically on transcription calls. Free tier supported without a credit card; paid models billed at cost with no markup and failed requests are not billed. Audio input is base64-only (URLs not supported); streaming isn't available for the transcription endpoint.

OpenRouter-Classifiers.name: OpenRouter Classifiers
OpenRouter-Classifiers.description: OpenRouter's beta classifier system (launched July 24, 2026) — automatically tags every OpenRouter generation with structured metadata for AI usage reporting. Each classifier is a small config with a taxonomy (up to eight dimensions, e.g. department, task type, agent complexity, compliance category), a system prompt, a model (Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite recommended for cost), and a sampling rate. Classification runs asynchronously after requests complete, so it never adds latency to the inference path. Outputs are coerced into structured formats constrained to the taxonomy dimensions and values. Works even with input and output logging disabled. Filter logs by classification (e.g. `department: legal`, `agent_complexity_difficulty_tier: complex_multistep`) and feed the tags into the Activity Explorer to see which models are used for each task type, which departments drive the most spend, and how patterns shift over time.

Atlassian.name: Forge LLMs API
Atlassian.description: Atlassian's generally available LLM API for the Forge developer platform (GA July 29, 2026 after June preview). Lets any Forge app bring LLM intelligence directly into Atlassian apps from inside the Atlassian trust boundary — no separate AI account, credentials, or billing setup. 100+ apps in production since Preview, 350+ in development, 20+ public Marketplace apps serving customers (risk management, diagramming, workflow automation, content quality). Backed by Amazon Bedrock, now natively built into Forge's core infrastructure: current model selection includes Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Opus 4.7 and 4.8. Simple SDK, more model tiers planned. Sits alongside Forge custom Rovo agents and skills in Atlassian's broader AI building-block set.

Google.name: Vertex AI
Google.description: Managed training, serving, and agent deployment on Google Cloud. Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform for agent development. Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite in preview.

Microsoft.name: Azure AI Foundry
Microsoft.description: Managed deployment, monitoring, and model routing on Azure. Supports models from OpenAI, Meta, Mistral, and more. MAI-Thinking-1 in private preview (June 2, 2026).

Amazon.name: SageMaker AI
Amazon.description: Managed model training, deployment, and MLOps workflows on AWS. Bedrock for inference, SageMaker for training. Claude Fable 5 was on Bedrock (June 9, 2026) in US East (N. Virginia) and Europe (Stockholm) — SUSPENDED June 12–June 30, 2026 by US export control directive — REDEPLOYED July 1, 2026 after US export controls lifted (new safety classifier blocks the Amazon-reported technique in 99%+ cases). Managed Knowledge Base on Bedrock AgentCore GA June 17, 2026 — connect unstructured data sources, AgentCore handles the rest; AgentCore Web Search GA same day.

NVIDIA.name: NIM
NVIDIA.description: Containerized inference microservices for enterprise deployment (NIM 2.0 with custom model support). One container, one backend philosophy. Built on vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang. Vera Rubin NVL72 systems ramped into full production (May 31, 2026) with 10x agent throughput vs Grace Blackwell. Nemotron 3 Ultra NIM 2.0.5 (June 4, 2026). NVIDIA Blackwell leads the first Agentic AI Infrastructure Benchmark (June 12, 2026). Hosted on build.nvidia.com.

NVIDIA-Vera.name: Vera CPU
NVIDIA-Vera.description: NVIDIA's first CPU built for agentic AI (launched March 16, 2026), ramping into full production as part of Vera Rubin NVL72 platform (May 31, 2026). 88 custom Olympus cores, Arm-compatible, 2x efficiency, 50% faster than traditional rack-scale CPUs. 1.8 TB/s NVLink-C2C coherent bandwidth pairs with Rubin GPUs. Deployed by Alibaba Cloud, ByteDance, Meta, Oracle Cloud, and NVIDIA Cloud Partners (CoreWeave, Crusoe, Lambda, Nebius, Nscale, Together AI). July 24, 2026: NVIDIA announced it is putting Vera CPUs to work alongside AI agents (Rubin-based agentic workflows) to speed up internal chip design — RTL exploration, verification, and physical design loops run on Vera Rubin NVL72 racks with autonomous agent orchestration.

HuggingFace.name: Inference Endpoints
HuggingFace.description: Dedicated hosting for open models with autoscaling and observability. Inference Pro API with serverless deployment.

Replicate.name: Replicate
Replicate.description: API-first model hosting and deployment for multimodal workloads. Open-source model serving. Replicate marketplace additions in the last week: Alibaba Happyhorse 1.1 (June 22, 2026 — text/image/reference-to-video with multilingual lip-sync, 720p/108p, up to 9 reference images); ByteDance Seedance 2.0 4K output (June 23, 2026); ByteDance Seedance 2.0 Mini (June 25, 2026 — ~2x speed, ~half the cost of the full model).

Alibaba.name: PAI-EAS
Alibaba.description: Elastic algorithm service for model serving on Alibaba Cloud. Supports Qwen and custom models.

vLLM.name: vLLM
vLLM.description: Open-source high-throughput serving engine used in self-hosted stacks. Powers many cloud providers.

OpenRouter.name: OpenRouter
OpenRouter.description: Unified LLM router exposing 400+ active models from 70+ providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Meta, Mistral, DeepSeek, xAI, Cohere, Moonshot, etc.) behind a single OpenAI-compatible API. One key, one billing layer, automatic failover and fallback across providers. Free tier with rate limits; paid models billed at cost (no markup). BYOK option to use your own provider keys with cached throughput discounts. App attribution via HTTP-Referer header for analytics and revenue sharing. Route parameters let you pin to specific providers, set fallbacks, enforce data policies (zero-retention endpoints), or sort by price/latency. Web search, structured output, tool calling, prompt caching supported across providers.

OpenRouter-Advisor.name: OpenRouter Advisor
OpenRouter-Advisor.description: Server-side tool for model self-escalation (GA June 10, 2026). Lets any executor model call a smarter advisor model mid-generation. Cross-vendor pairing, multiple named advisors, advisor gets its own tool loop including web search.

OpenRouter-Subagent.name: OpenRouter Subagent
OpenRouter-Subagent.description: Server-side tool for delegating routine work to cheaper worker models (June 16, 2026). Tokens bill at worker's own rate. Pairs with Advisor - orchestrator delegates busywork to subagent while consulting advisor.

OpenRouter-MCP.name: OpenRouter MCP Server
OpenRouter-MCP.description: MCP server for live OpenRouter data (June 25, 2026). Tools: models-list, model-get, benchmarks (Artificial Analysis + Design Arena), rankings-daily, chat-send, docs-search, credits-get.

OpenRouter-Image.name: OpenRouter Image API
OpenRouter-Image.description: Dedicated image generation API (June 23, 2026) unifying 30+ image models from Google, OpenAI, BFL, Recraft, ByteDance, Sourceful, Microsoft, xAI. Endpoints API exposes exact USD cost per generation.

OpenRouter-Fusion.name: OpenRouter Fusion
OpenRouter-Fusion.description: Model Fusion server tool (June 12, 2026) — orchestrates a panel of budget models fused through OpenRouter to outscore frontier models on complex tasks. In a 100-task research eval, a fused panel beat GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.8 while costing a fraction per token. Configurable via openrouter:fusion server tool with model set, strategy (parallel/sequential), and synthesis options. Designed for agentic workloads that need frontier-grade quality at budget prices.

Google.name: AI Studio
Google.description: Fast browser workspace for prompt prototyping and Gemini app iteration. File Search multimodal update May 5. Veo 3.1 Ingredients to Video and 4K upscaling.

OpenAI.name: Playground
OpenAI.description: Prompt, eval, and tool testing workspace for GPT-5.5 and platform APIs. Responses API testing. Realtime voice model testing (gpt-realtime-2, May 7, 2026). GPT Image 2 playground for text/infographic/image-set generation.

JetBrains.name: AI Assistant
JetBrains.description: In-IDE assistant for completion, chat, refactors, and team model routing. Junie integration, ACP Agent Registry, BYOK support. Mellum2 12B open-source model (June 1, 2026, Apache 2.0) integrates into IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, and Android Studio via the AI Assistant plugin for local/on-prem code intelligence — base, instruct, and thinking checkpoints on Hugging Face, runs in PyTorch/GGUF with Ollama and vLLM support. TeamCity AI Assistant in Enterprise trial.

JetBrains-Context.name: JetBrains Context
JetBrains-Context.description: JetBrains's repository intelligence layer for coding agents (early access from July 21, 2026, included with JetBrains AI subscription). Incrementally builds a semantic index of repositories and exposes semantic retrieval tools so agents like Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Junie CLI can ask questions directly instead of repeatedly searching and reading files. Multi-repo search discovers relevant code across an organization's codebase, including repositories not checked out locally — validates APIs/dependencies, surfaces reusable code, enforces architecture conformity. Validated on 205 open-source SWE-bench tasks, 175 production-monorepo tasks, and 1,953 code-localization tasks: up to 68% fewer agent turns, 59% lower latency, 48% lower execution cost. Source code stays local; the backend never stores source. `jbcontext` CLI for setup, login, indexing, analytics. Recommended Agent in AI Chat now defaults to Codex for JVM/.NET/Python.

HuggingFace-Tau.name: Tau
HuggingFace-Tau.description: Hugging Face's open-source coding agent (launched July 22, 2026) designed as both a production-ready terminal agent and an interactive educational curriculum for understanding agent architecture. Deconstructs agent complexity into distinct learnable components — agent brain (harness), coding environment (files/shell/sessions), and Textual TUI — to teach event streams, tool calls, transcript management, and session persistence. Inspired by Pi but reimagined as a Python learning path; architectural clarity via event-based design where agents emit transparent event streams rather than callbacks. Each layer — provider adapters, agent harness, coding environment, frontend — operates independently. Production-credible while being comprehensible for learners.

Vercel.name: Vercel Agent
Vercel.description: Vercel's production-first responder for deployed apps and agents (expanded July 21, 2026). Lives in the Vercel Dashboard; autonomously investigates production logs, metrics, and deployments when something changes, finds the root cause, and proposes a fix before you've opened your laptop. Read-only by default; works under its own identity; reach it through Vercel Dashboard, GitHub, and the CLI. Per-action permission model: proposing a plan (rollback deploy, change config, clear cache) requests access scoped specifically to that plan, and the agent drops back to read-only after completion. Code generated by the agent runs in Vercel Sandbox, an ephemeral Firecracker microVM isolated from live systems. Capabilities: review a pull request and flag performance regressions a passing CI run won't show; trace a cost increase back to the change that caused it; fix a broken build by reading logs, asking permission, and testing in a sandbox. Coming soon: delegation to specialists (deep security review, design/UX review). Available to Pro and Enterprise teams; enable in the Agent section of the dashboard.

Cursor.name: Background Agent (owned by SpaceX)
Cursor.description: Async dev workflows for longer tasks inside the Cursor coding environment. Cursor 3 unified workspace (April 2, 2026) and v3.2 (April 24) add /multitask, worktrees, and multi-root workspaces. Development environments for cloud agents (May 13, 2026). Automations in Marketplace templates.

HuggingFace.name: Gradio
HuggingFace.description: UI toolkit for demos, eval apps, and internal AI developer tools. Diffusers 0.38.0 with new pipelines.

LangChain.name: LangSmith
LangChain.description: Tracing, evaluation, prompt management, and observability for agent stacks. LangGraph Platform for enterprise. LangSmith Engine (Interrupt 2026) watches production traces, clusters failures, diagnoses root causes, proposes fixes. LangSmith Sandboxes GA (May 13, 2026) — secure, kernel-isolated microVMs for agent code execution with parallel workloads, snapshotting, Service URLs, Sandbox CLI, Auth Proxy with custom callbacks. Deep Agents v0.6 with Delta Channels in langgraph v1.2 — checkpoint storage grows linearly instead of O(N²) for long message histories.

Kilo.name: Kilo Code
Kilo.description: Cloud coding agent with Mistral Medium 3.5, VS Code extension, CLI. Remote async sessions that open PRs on GitHub. Integrates with Tencent Hy3 preview.

HuggingFace-Serge.name: Serge
HuggingFace-Serge.description: HuggingFace's GitHub-native AI code reviewer (announced June 12, 2026, Apache 2.0). Reviews pull requests with any OpenAI-compatible LLM, follows repository-owned review rules in `.ai/review-rules.md`, and publishes inline comments through GitHub's review experience. Runs as a GitHub Action for single-repo CI, a GitHub App webhook for org-wide automation, or a staged web app for human-in-the-loop reviews. Compatible with OpenAI, the Hugging Face Router, local vLLM/TGI/LM Studio endpoints. Triggered with `@askserge please review`; bubblewrap sandboxing (June 9) isolates fork PR code from review host. Code at github.com/huggingface/serge. June 17, 2026: Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) specification published — open draft from Microsoft, Google, GoDaddy, Hugging Face, and others; defines how agents/tools are cataloged/indexed/searched across federated registries so agents find capabilities at runtime. Hugging Face Discover Tool is the reference implementation: searches thousands of Skills, ML apps, and MCP Servers on the Hub and across other ARD services, exposed as ARD catalog entries; built into the `hf` CLI.

Meta.name: AI Studio
Meta.description: Platform to create custom AI characters for entertainment, productivity, and support. Build conversational AIs with personality, knowledge, tone, and image generation. Share via Messenger, Instagram, WhatsApp.

Google-Stitch.name: Stitch Skills
Google-Stitch.description: Google Labs stitch-skills (released July 11, 2026, 6.9k GitHub stars) — official Agent Skills library that packages Google Stitch (AI UI design tool) into plugins for coding agents following the Agent Skills open standard. Officially supports Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, and Antigravity. Three plugin sets: stitch-design (convert code → Stitch designs, generate UI screens, manage design systems), stitch-build (turn designs into React and React Native components with shadcn/ui integration), stitch-utilities (design analysis, spec generation). stitch-loop skill implements a 'baton pattern' — agent builds an entire multi-page website autonomously by reading the next task, generating the page, and writing the next task, repeating until done. All design operations go through the Stitch MCP server (config once per agent). A Google product shipping first-party skills for every rival's agent via open standard interop.

Google.name: Vertex AI Agent Builder
Google.description: Google orchestration layer for search, tools, and production agents. Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. Managed Agents API for autonomous Linux sandbox agents (May 2026).

OpenAI.name: Agent Platform
OpenAI.description: Agent Builder, Agents SDK, ChatKit, and eval tooling on GPT-5.5. WebSocket-based execution mode for lower latency.

OpenAI-Work.name: ChatGPT Work
OpenAI-Work.description: ChatGPT's new long-running agent (launched July 9, 2026) powered by GPT-5.6. Gathers information across apps and workflows, returns finished sheets, slides, docs, and web apps; stays with complex projects for hours by breaking them into smaller steps and completing them independently. Web/mobile first for Pro, Enterprise, and Edu today; Plus and Business over the next few days. ChatGPT desktop app now combines Chat, Work, and Codex across Mac and Windows — Free desktop available in every plan. Frame for work that needs hours of focus, not single prompts.

Anthropic.name: Computer Use
Anthropic.description: Claude Opus 4.8 computer control and tool use for autonomous task execution. Claude Fable 5 (Mythos-class) — SUSPENDED June 12–June 30, 2026 by US export control directive — REDEPLOYED July 1, 2026 after US export controls lifted (new safety classifier blocks the Amazon-reported technique in 99%+ cases). MCP connector beta. Financial services agent templates for pitchbooks, KYC, month-end close.

Microsoft.name: Copilot Studio
Microsoft.description: Enterprise copilot orchestration for workflows, connectors, and approvals. GPT-5.5 Chat and GPT-5.5 Reasoning model options. MAI-Thinking-1 (June 2, 2026) and Claude Fable 5 (SUSPENDED June 12–June 30, 2026 by US export control directive — REDEPLOYED July 1, 2026 after US export controls lifted (new safety classifier blocks the Amazon-reported technique in 99%+ cases)) in Copilot.

Amazon.name: Bedrock AgentCore
Amazon.description: Agent development platform with managed harness, AgentCore CLI, and pre-built skills. Runtime, Memory, Gateway, Browser, Code Interpreter, Identity, Policy, Observability, Evaluations. Supports LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, Strands. S3/EFS filesystem mounting (May 2026). Claude Fable 5 was on Bedrock with 30-day data retention (June 9, 2026) — SUSPENDED June 12–June 30, 2026 by US export control directive — REDEPLOYED July 1, 2026 after US export controls lifted (new safety classifier blocks the Amazon-reported technique in 99%+ cases). June 17, 2026 (AWS Summit New York): AgentCore harness now GA — build/run production agents in minutes via configuration (model, tools, skills, instructions). Web Search on AgentCore — fully managed web search that grounds agents in current web knowledge while keeping queries inside the customer's AWS security boundary, powered by the same search infrastructure that backs Alexa+, Amazon Quick Suite, and Kiro. AgentCore payments (preview since May) lets agents discover and pay for paid services/content inside the agent loop. WAF AI traffic monetization now GA — content providers control agent access (block, allow, or get paid) and automatically recognize agent traffic. Failure/intent/trajectory insights (preview, 13 regions) find silent agent failures, cluster requests by user intent, group agent trajectory patterns. Batch evaluations, recommendations, and A/B testing now GA (14 regions) — grounded in production traces, validate before rollout, measure under live traffic split. Works on AgentCore runtime, Lambda, EKS, or non-AWS environments.

Cresta.name: Cresta Conductor
Cresta.description: Cresta's developer-first agentic engine for building and optimizing AI agents on the Cresta platform (launched June 11, 2026). Natural-language engine for the entire agent lifecycle: grounded discovery, blueprint generation, end-to-end build (prompts, subagent orchestration, configurations, custom code), iterative pre-launch testing with Cresta Synthetic Customers, and post-launch diagnostics with autonomous fixes. Cuts initial agent deployment timelines by ~50%; custom functions that took a week now ship in 1-2 days. Hybrid architecture combining agentic AI with human agent expertise across voice, chat, and omnichannel. MCP-based tool standardization.

Sakana.name: Sakana Fugu Orchestration
Sakana.description: Sakana AI's learned multi-agent orchestration API (launched June 22, 2026). Instead of hand-coding supervisor/sub-agent wiring, Fugu learns to route across frontier LLMs (Claude, GPT, Gemini) per task. Sakana Fugu Ultra extends the routing with budgeted reasoning and tool-use steps. OpenAI-compatible chat/completions interface; deployable behind a single API key for production agentic workloads.

Runway.name: Runway Agent 2.0
Runway.description: Marketing AI agent from Runway launched June 25, 2026. Pulls in creative assets and ad performance data from Meta, YouTube, TikTok, and Google, then generates next-round ad variants, localizes campaigns across regions (preserves approved core assets, fits each market's format requirements), and produces a week's worth of on-brand social content cut into platform-specific formats (9:16 for Reels/Stories, 16:9 for YouTube, 1:1 for feed) in a single session. Retains campaign context across requests.

Google-AlphaEvolve.name: AlphaEvolve
Google-AlphaEvolve.description: Google's Gemini-powered evolutionary coding agent (now GA to all Google Cloud customers as of July 9, 2026 via Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform). User provides a seed program plus a scoring function; AlphaEvolve uses Gemini to propose code changes, evaluates candidates against the user-supplied evaluator, and evolves the population toward better solutions over generations. Generation half is fully managed in Google's cloud (LLM ensemble supports gemini-3.5-flash and gemini-3.1-pro-preview with configurable weights); evaluation half runs wherever the user chooses — local exec() sandbox, Cloud Run function, or GKE + Ray GPU cluster. Optimizes anything the user can score (pure-Python heuristics, compiled Rust/C++, full ML training runs). Adopted by BASF, JetBrains, Kinaxis since the December 2025 private preview.

Microsoft-Agent-Framework.name: Microsoft Agent Framework Harness
Microsoft-Agent-Framework.description: Microsoft's production-ready agent runtime (Harness released July 15-22, 2026) for the Agent Framework line that succeeded AutoGen and Semantic Kernel. Opinionated, batteries-included harness wrapping a chat client with a complete agentic pipeline — planning, memory, context management, approvals, tool orchestration, telemetry — tuned for long-running autonomous work like research, data analysis, and general task automation. Python 1.12 and .NET 1.14 shipped July 21, 2026 with two production-shape changes: app-owned MCP hosting helpers expose your agents and workflows as native MCP tools (your agent becomes an MCP server, not just a client), and an alpha Azure Cosmos DB semantic-memory context provider with fact extraction and user profiles gives agents persistent memory that outlives the session. Stable graduation: declarative workflows, tool-approval middleware, and file memory provider graduated to stable in Python. Available across Microsoft Foundry and developer machines.

Microsoft-SharePoint-Apps.name: SharePoint Copilot Apps
Microsoft-SharePoint-Apps.description: Microsoft's new way to deliver action-oriented, app-like experiences inside Microsoft 365 Copilot (entered public preview July 9, 2026 via SPFx 1.24 preview; full worldwide rollout targeted by July 20, 2026). Built on SPFx 1.24 with industry-standard web stack, MCP Apps, and the SPFx packaging model — hosted automatically in Microsoft 365 tenant at no extra setup. Replaces 'wall-of-text chat' with concrete one-click app flows (approve an expense, triage an incident, run an onboarding checklist) inside the Copilot canvas. Shipped with Copilot Workbench and full developer experience; APIs and the 'SharePoint Copilot Apps' working name subject to change before GA.

Cogent.name: Cogent AI Harness
Cogent.description: Cogent Security's governed runtime for cyber-defense agents (released July 27, 2026 alongside VR-1). Wraps any capable model -- open-weight or frontier -- with environment context, scoped tools, policy enforcement, and verification so it can operate as a governed security agent inside a live enterprise. Every action is checked against the customer's own policy and backed by evidence; Cogent's validation principle is 'prove, don't detonate' -- exposure is confirmed without causing damage, persistence, or disruption. Available through the Cogent Frontier Access Program.

HubSpot.name: Agent Hub & Agent Builder
HubSpot.description: HubSpot's agentic customer platform (public beta launched July 23, 2026 for Professional and Enterprise customers). Agent Hub provides a single console to see every active agent across the go-to-market (marketing/sales/service), organize them by goal (demand, deals, customers, growth), and activate unused ones with one click. Agent Builder is the no-code canvas for building/iterating custom agents and automations in plain language via Breeze Assistant, with unified workflows, custom agents, and triggers all in one canvas. Custom agents run on HubSpot Credits (included in Pro/Enterprise, more available for purchase); agents share the customer data foundation (deal history, contact records, call transcripts, buying signals) so coordination happens at the data layer rather than via manual handoffs. Triggered from schedules, contact updates, webhooks, or third-party integrations. Frames HubSpot as the 'Agentic Customer Platform' for SMBs and mid-market teams where AI agent management ships as standard rather than enterprise upsell.

Google.name: Imagen 4
Google.description: Google image generation stack surfaced through Gemini and Vertex AI. Gemini 3.1 Flash Image Preview (Nano Banana 2) at #3 on Image Arena. Gemini Omni (video) and Veo 3.1 in production. Gemini 3.5 Flash gained native Computer Use (June 25, 2026) — 78.4 on OSWorld, ahead of Gemini 3 Flash (65.1) and GPT-5.4 mini (72.1); trails GPT-5.5 (78.7) and Opus 4.8 (83.4). Available via Gemini API and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform with prompt-injection safeguards. Gemini 3.5 Pro GA pushed from June to July 2026 (June 23 announcement) to incorporate early-tester feedback — 2M-token context and Deep Think reasoning mode still planned. Google DeepMind + A24 research partnership announced June 22, 2026 for creator-facing AI tooling.

Google-NanoBanana-Lite.name: Nano Banana 2 Lite
Google-NanoBanana-Lite.description: Google's fastest image generation and editing model in the Nano Banana family (Nano Banana 2 Lite / Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Image, GA June 30, 2026). Generates an image in as little as 4 seconds. Built for A/B testing ad variations and high-volume social apps.

OpenAI.name: GPT Image 2
OpenAI.description: Powered by ChatGPT Images 2.0 (gpt-image-2, April 21, 2026) — top-ranked on Image Arena. Thinkable generation mode, multilingual text rendering (Japanese, Korean, Hindi, Bengali), 4K resolution, complex infographics and comic strips. Available in ChatGPT and the API; gpt-image-1.5 deprecated as default.

Microsoft-MAI-Image-2.5-Pro.name: MAI-Image-2.5-Pro
Microsoft-MAI-Image-2.5-Pro.description: Microsoft's highest-fidelity image model, released in public preview July 23, 2026. Designed for hero imagery, detailed editing, and precise in-image text rendering; available through Microsoft Foundry and MAI Playground. Priced at $5 per 1M text input tokens, $8 per 1M image input tokens, and $106 per 1M image output tokens.

Meta.name: Muse Image
Meta.description: Meta Superintelligence Labs' first image generation model (launched July 7, 2026, ai.meta.com). Follows instructions faithfully, edits with precision, composes from multiple references, draws on Instagram for social context, brings agentic tool use, and integrates with Muse Spark. Content Seal invisible watermarking system stamps all Meta AI / meta.ai generations (resists crop/compress/resize/screenshot). Available in the Meta AI app and on meta.ai, Instagram Stories in the US, and WhatsApp in limited countries; coming soon to Facebook. Coming to advertisers via Advantage+ in the following weeks.

Adobe.name: Firefly
Adobe.description: Commercially safe image generation for creative and marketing workflows. Part of Adobe's agentic CX platform including Experience Platform Agent Orchestrator and CX Enterprise Coworker (April 20, 2026, GA coming months). Firefly AI Assistant (public beta) and the upgraded Firefly creative AI studio rolled out June 18, 2026: new Elements (reusable characters/environments you can drop into scenes), Projects (grouped assets/context), brand kit generation, storyboards, Quick Cut video editing, image-to-video from storyboards. AI Assistant in public beta across Premiere, Photoshop, Illustrator, Frame.io, InDesign (private beta in After Effects). Upgraded AI studio in private beta via waitlist at firefly.adobe.com/studio.

Midjourney.name: Midjourney
Midjourney.description: V8.2 became the default model on midjourney.com on July 24, 2026 (as the default version per docs). V8.2 focuses on aesthetics, image quality, and Personalization — images are more creative, bold, sophisticated, edgy and fresh; low-quality random outputs are dramatically reduced; Personalization now understands personal taste much better (especially with many ratings under the profile); and the personalization-profile creation pool is much larger and improved. V8.1 was the default from June 10, 2026 through July 23, 2026, having launched April 30, 2026 on Discord and web. V8.0 alpha deprecated within two weeks of June 10, 2026. V7 omni-reference still used for OREF features until V8 version is ready. Moodboards and sref stable. June 3, 2026 office hours: V8.2 delayed to this month for aesthetic upgrade and personalization; new multi-reference editing model in development (instruction-based editing, camera control, multi-character coherence, OREF for V8) with first versions in dataset/model refinement; V9 research prep begun; major site/prompt-bar redesign in testing (50+ user research sessions informed unified settings/prompt surface, two-way sync between parameters and prompts). Larger batch generation in active testing, new upscaler in development. June 10, 2026 office hours: Korean translation pilot via Crowdin, larger-batch generation mostly through interface work.

StabilityAI.name: Stable Diffusion 3.5
StabilityAI.description: Stability AI's flagship open image model family (SD 3.5 Large 8.1B, Large Turbo, Medium 2.5B) plus API products Stable Image Ultra (powered by SD3.5 Large, $0.08/image) and Stable Image Core (next-gen after SDXL, $0.03/image). SD3.0 APIs deprecated. NVIDIA TensorRT-optimized SD 3.5 (June 12, 2026) — 2.3x faster generation on Large, 1.7x on Medium, 40% less VRAM, available on RTX 50/40 Series, Blackwell, Ada Lovelace RTX PRO. Available via Stability AI NIM, Hugging Face, and self-hosted.

BlackForest.name: FLUX.2
BlackForest.description: Black Forest Labs' current image model family. FLUX.2 [pro] production-grade at $0.03/MP with multi-reference (up to 10 images), 4MP output, exact hex color control, structured prompting. FLUX.2 [flex] for typography and fine-grained control. FLUX.2 [klein] 4B/9B open-weight models (Apache 2.0) with sub-0.5s inference on consumer GPUs since Jan 15, 2026 — first FLUX model shipping on consumer hardware via ASUS ProArt laptops with NVIDIA optimization (June 4, 2026). FLUX.2 [dev] 32B open-weight. Replaces FLUX.1 line. flux-2-pro-preview endpoint for speed upgrades, FLUX Erase (May 21, 2026) for mask-based object removal beating GPT Image-2, FLUX VTO (May 28, 2026) virtual try-on for retail catalog scale. FLUX 3 (July 23, 2026) is BFL's new multimodal frontier model — see FLUX-3 entry under Foundation Models (Open Model) — jointly trained on image/video/audio with FLUX 3 Video (up to 20-second clips with native audio) and FLUX 3 Action (FLUX-mimic robotics) in gated Early Access; FLUX 3 Image and FLUX 3 Dev (open-weight multimodal) coming later.

Reve.name: Reve 2.0
Reve.description: Reve AI's layout-first image model (June 3, 2026) — #2 on Text-to-Image Arena with 1280 score (+125 from 1.5), behind GPT Image 2 and ahead of Gemini 3.1 Flash Image Preview (Nano Banana 2). Proprietary model from Palo Alto startup; ensemble approach. API access with layout-based creative control.

Ideogram.name: Ideogram 4.0
Ideogram.description: Ideogram's open-weight frontier text-to-image foundation model (June 3, 2026) — first Ideogram release as open weights under commercial license. 9.3B parameter single-stream DiT (34 transformer layers, QK-RMSNorm, MRoPE) with Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct as the frozen text encoder. Trained exclusively on structured JSON captions with bounding-box layout control and color palettes. #1 open-weight image model and #2 overall in designer-preference ELO (1062, behind only GPT Image 2's 1141 — ahead of Nano Banana 2, Grok Imagine 2K, Luma 1.1, FLUX.2 Pro). Frontier text rendering across languages with bounding-box layout control, 2K photoreal output, and a layer-based generation stack (transparent layers now; editable text and movable image layers in follow-up release; branded-asset generation with typography/palette/logo fidelity soon after). HQ Toronto/SF. Distributed via ideogram.ai, Ideogram API, Ideogram Background Remover; open weights on GitHub. Customers can fine-tune on own brand data, audit training data, run on own hardware. Designed for production design workflows — headlines change, cutouts drop onto new backdrops.

Apple.name: Image Playground
Apple.description: Apple's image generation API reimagined at WWDC26 (June 1, 2026) with a powerful new generative model running on Private Cloud Compute that produces high-quality images in virtually any style, including photorealistic output. People can start from a photo or description, refine images using natural language or touch, and choose landscape or portrait dimensions. All new capabilities are exposed through the Image Playground API for third-party apps. Systemwide Visual Intelligence also expanded to iPad, Mac, and Apple Vision Pro (iOS 27 / iPadOS 27 / macOS 27 / visionOS 27). Free software update this fall on Apple Intelligence-capable devices.

SpaceXAI.name: Grok Imagine API
SpaceXAI.description: xAI image generation with Quality Mode (May 6). grok-imagine-image-quality for higher realism, text rendering. grok-imagine-image-pro retired May 15, 2026. Grok Imagine 1.5 Preview (grok-imagine-video-1.5-preview, June 3, 2026) for image-to-video at 720p with synchronized audio, #1 on Artificial Analysis Video Arena Image-to-Video (Elo 1404), 15-second clips. June 16-17, 2026: Grok Imagine Video 1.5 GA on xAI API (model id grok-imagine-video-1.5) — audio (sound effects, ambience, dialogue) generated in the same pass, better motion/physics with fewer warps, more believable weight/momentum; Fast variant produces 6-second 720p video in ~25 seconds (down from 40+ on previous model). New in Grok Imagine: Projects sidebar for organizing work, multi-agent parallel generation, search across image/video library.

Microsoft.name: MAI-Image-2.5
Microsoft.description: Microsoft's MAI-Image-2.5 family (June 2, 2026, Build 2026) ranks #2 on Arena image edit leaderboard ahead of Nano Banana 2, with MAI-Image-2.5-Flash for high-volume workloads. Text-to-image and image-to-image with 'control with preservation' editing. Live in PowerPoint, rolling out to OneDrive, available in Foundry. MAI-Image-2.5: $5/$8 per 1M text/image input, $47 per 1M image output. MAI-Image-2.5-Flash: $1.75 per 1M text/image input, $19 per 1M image output. Also on OpenRouter.

Amazon.name: Titan Image
Amazon.description: Bedrock image model family for enterprise-safe generation and editing.

Google.name: Veo 3.1
Google.description: Google's flagship video generation model (Veo 3.1 updates shipped January 13, 2026) for cinematic and prompt-driven clips with native audio. Enhanced Ingredients to Video, native 9:16 vertical output, 4K upscaling, improved character/background consistency. Available in Gemini API, AI Studio, Vertex AI, Flow, YouTube Shorts, Google Vids.

Google-Omni-Flash.name: Gemini Omni Flash
Google-Omni-Flash.description: Google's conversational video generation and editing model (public preview June 30, 2026). Powers character/product swaps, dynamic style transfers, object addition, scene relighting. Generates video from text, a first-frame image, or an existing video. Available via Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform and the Runway API as `gemini_omni_flash`.

Runway.name: Runway
Runway.description: Gen-4.5 video generation and editing suite for creators and teams. Aleph 2.0 with Edit Studio (May 21, 2026) edits 30s 1080p clips with frame propagation across cuts; Aleph 2.0 also on the Runway API (June 2, 2026, identifier `aleph2`) with 2-30s inputs, up to 5 keyframe images, and content moderation. Seedance 2.0 on Runway API (April 7, 2026) and Seedance 2.0 Fast (June 5, 2026, `seedance2_fast`) with 4-15s generations, 480p/720p, keyframe control, reference images/videos, and generated audio. Runway MCP server (May 27, 2026) connects Runway to any MCP-compatible agent (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) with Gen-4.5, Seedance 2.0, GPT Image 2, Kling 3.0, Nano Banana Pro, Seedream 5.0, FLUX.2 [max]. Characters API for real-time conversational video agents (May 4, 2026). GWM-1 world model family. June 11-17, 2026: Lionsgate takes undisclosed equity stake in Runway and signs preferred partnership (expansion of 2024 collaboration) — joint development program to create new IP starting with a short-form episodic series drawing on Lionsgate's existing IP and Runway's generative models; Lionsgate is presenting partner at Runway AI Festival June 2026. First Hollywood studio to take equity in an applied AI research company. Aleph 2.0 aspect-ratio scene expansion launched June 22, 2026 — input a video, Aleph expands the scene to fit any new aspect ratio so the output looks like it was filmed that way (Runway Academy tutorial same day). Runway platform added Seedance 2.0 4K output (ByteDance), Seedance 2.0 Mini, and Kling 3.0 Turbo on June 23, 2026 — world's best video/image models now aggregated in Runway's UI/API alongside its own Aleph 2.0. Localize Ads feature launched June 25, 2026: input one ad creative, produce language-localized versions for every market with one click. Runway Agent 2.0 launched June 25, 2026 — AI agent for marketers that pulls in paid-ads performance data (Meta, YouTube, TikTok, Google), generates next-round ad variants, localizes campaigns across regions, and cuts a week of on-brand social content into platform-specific formats in one session.

Runway Characters.name: Runway Characters
Runway Characters.description: Character animation API for real-time conversational video agents. Part of Runway's Characters API platform (May 4, 2026). Powers Aleph 2.0 multi-shot handling.

Runway-Media-Router.name: Runway Media Router
Runway-Media-Router.description: Runway's first generative-media-specific model router (API changelog July 23, 2026 via Runway Dev). Create a saved routing configuration once and reference it by `configId` to route video, image, and audio generations to the best model for the use case — the router filters to eligible models and selects one based on the optimization preference (cost, latency, or quality), so developers never have to name a model. Configure model allow/deny lists and optional per-modality credit ceilings (`video`, `image`, `audio`). Preview routing decisions with `dryRun` before generating. Pairs the same routing tech Runway builds for its own products with access to the growing roster of third-party image, video, and audio models on Runway Dev (Gen-4.5, Aleph 2.0, Act-Two, Seedance 2.0, GPT Image 2, ElevenLabs, and more). Customers already on Runway Dev include Adobe, Cloudflare, ElevenLabs, Expedia, Shutterstock, and Quora.

MiniMax.name: Hailuo Video
MiniMax.description: MiniMax's video generation platform (Hailuo 2.3, May 31, 2026) with Media Agent. Enhanced dynamic expression, physical action, micro-expressions, motion commands. Same pricing as Hailuo 02. Hailuo 2.3 Fast at 50% lower cost. 1080p native, ranked top globally.

HeyGen.name: HeyGen
HeyGen.description: Avatar-first video generation with enterprise localization and dubbing flows. May 2026: Avatar V with Custom Motion (direct face/hands/posture/gaze/energy in plain English), Avatar V API ($0.05/second), LiveAvatar real-time conversational avatars, HyperFrames (turns HTML/agent markup into finished video), HyperFrames as official Claude connector (June 10, 2026). Native Android app. Integrations: Superhuman, Codex, Canva, Lovable (MCP/OAuth). $29/mo.

Pika.name: Pika 2.5
Pika.description: Pika 2.5 (current production as of early 2026) with rebuilt physics engine, layered motion control (pan/tilt/zoom/dolly/orbit), Pikaframes scene extension to 15-25s, 4K upscaling, sharper textures, sound-to-video synchronization. Pika 2.5 Studio timeline editor, Pikaffects 2.0 (Melt, Inflate, Explode, Squish, Cake-ify), Pikaswaps, Pikadditions, Pika MCP. 12s individual clips at 1080p. API via fal.ai, $0.05/second. Standard $8/mo, Pro $28/mo, Fancy $58/mo.

ByteDance.name: Seedance 2.0
ByteDance.description: ByteDance multimodal video generation with audio-video joint architecture. Seedance 2.0 was promoted to native 4K / 10-bit output (July 2026) on CapCut, Dreamina, Jimeng, BytePlus ModelArk, and Volcano Engine. Seedance 2.5 API went live July 21, 2026 (unveiled at Volcano Engine FORCE) — 30-second single-shot clips in one continuous generation (no stitching), up to 50 multimodal reference inputs spanning images/video/audio/scripts/style guides, and 3D white-box camera control via green-screen plates or 3D blockouts — first 3D camera-blockout preview function in a video model. Independent pricing ~$1-2 per 30s clip at lower settings; no official rate card. Independent arena ranking pending — no neutral benchmark or model card yet. Cease-and-desist letters from Hollywood studios over Seedance 2.0 celebrity deepfakes remain outstanding; no confirmed US availability date.

Luma.name: Ray3.2
Luma.description: Luma's Ray3.2 model (released June 9, 2026) with frame-level multi-keyframe control (up to 16 keyframes), native HDR generation, 16-bit EXR export for VFX pipelines, 20s 1080p cinematic generations, and enhanced Reframe for surgical aspect-ratio edits. Ray3.2 API now available for direct pipeline integration (June 9, 2026). Free tier, Pro $30/mo, Enterprise custom.

Meta.name: Muse Video
Meta.description: Meta Superintelligence Labs' first video generation model (previewed July 7, 2026, ai.meta.com, alongside Muse Image). Built on the same pretraining base as Muse Image, native audio support (sound generated in the same pass — no separate audio pipeline). Currently #3 on Arena text-to-video leaderboard (Elo), behind Veo but ahead of most peers. Coming soon to creators and inside Meta AI; Content Seal watermark extension to video planned.

ElevenLabs.name: ElevenLabs Avatars
ElevenLabs.description: ElevenLabs Avatars (launched June 12, 2026) — photorealistic, lip-synced talking-head video generated in a single dashboard. Combines text-to-speech and lip-sync models operating simultaneously to generate consistent digital identities. Avatar Node in ElevenLabs Flows for automated text-to-avatar marketing video pipelines. Rolling out globally across all paid subscription tiers using the standard credit-based ecosystem. Ads Engine in ElevenCreative launched June 22, 2026 — connects Google, Meta, and LinkedIn ad accounts; localizes existing ads across 50+ languages and pushes finished creatives back to the ad platform. First 'engine' in ElevenCreative, with more engines teased. The Odyssey audiobook (narrated by Sir Michael Caine's cloned voice with original cinematic music and sound design) launched June 23, 2026 on ElevenReader as a showcase for high-fidelity voice cloning.

NVIDIA.name: SANA-WM
NVIDIA.description: 2.6B-parameter open-source world model generating minute-scale 720p video on a single GPU.

MiniMax-H3.name: H3 (Hailuo Video 3)
MiniMax-H3.description: MiniMax's omni-modal generation model (launched July 31, 2026) — accepts multimodal context arrays (text, images, video, audio) and generates 2K video up to 15 seconds with native stereo audio modeled jointly in a single forward pass. Stack: H3-Encoder, H3-VisualVAE, H3-AudioVAE, H3-Omni Transformer, In-Context Regeneration (H3-Context-IR). Three modes: T2VA (text-to-audio-video), FL2VA (first/last-frame-to-audio-video), Ref2VA (multimodal reference-to-audio-video, up to 12 mixed files). V2V motion transfer for camera moves between subjects. 24 FPS, 32 kHz native stereo, 11 stable dialogue languages (Arabic, Chinese, English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish) plus partial support for more. Pricing at 2K is 0.80 CNY/second (~$0.11), 768p in closed beta at 0.50 CNY/second — MiniMax claims <1/3 mainstream per-second price at 2K and <1/2 at 768p. Open weights promised 'in the coming days' under MiniMax H3 Community License; available today via MiniMax API (POST /v1/video_generation) and `minimax/minimax-h3` on Vercel AI Gateway.

Google.name: Cloud Text-to-Speech
Google.description: Google voice stack spanning WaveNet, neural, and studio-quality synthesis. Gemini Live for voice interaction. Gemini 3.5 Live Translate (June 9, 2026) for 70+ language live speech-to-speech translation. Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS (April 15, 2026) with audio tags for vocal style control. Gemini 3.5 Flash gained native Computer Use (June 25, 2026) — 78.4 on OSWorld, ahead of Gemini 3 Flash (65.1) and GPT-5.4 mini (72.1); trails GPT-5.5 (78.7) and Opus 4.8 (83.4). Available via Gemini API and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform with prompt-injection safeguards. Gemini 3.5 Pro GA pushed from June to July 2026 (June 23 announcement) to incorporate early-tester feedback — 2M-token context and Deep Think reasoning mode still planned. Google DeepMind + A24 research partnership announced June 22, 2026 for creator-facing AI tooling.

OpenAI.name: Realtime Voice
OpenAI.description: Speech generation powered by gpt-realtime-2.1 (July 6, 2026, improved alphanumeric recognition, silence/noise handling, interruption behavior), gpt-realtime-2.1-mini (faster, lower-cost), gpt-realtime-translate (70+ input, 13 output languages), gpt-realtime-whisper streaming STT. p95 latency reduced 25%+ via improved caching. GPT-Realtime-2 (May 7, 2026) remains available alongside -2.1. GPT-Live-1/Live-1 mini (full-duplex, July 8, 2026) is the ChatGPT consumer voice default. Realtime 2.1: $32/1M audio input, $64/1M output tokens.

OpenAI-Realtime-2.name: GPT-Realtime-2.1
OpenAI-Realtime-2.description: GPT-Realtime-2.1 released July 6, 2026 — successor to GPT-Realtime-2 (May 7, 2026, $32/$64 per 1M audio tokens). Improved alphanumeric recognition, silence/noise handling, interruption behavior for natural turn-taking. Speech-to-speech with configurable reasoning effort, instruction following, and tool use for complex voice-agent workflows. p95 latency reduced 25%+ across all Realtime models via improved caching. GPT-Realtime-2.1 mini for faster/lower-cost realtime. $4/$24 per 1M text tokens, $32/$64 audio, $5/$0.50 image. Alias `gpt-realtime-2.1` on the API with snapshot versioning.

OpenAI-Realtime-2-Mini.name: GPT-Realtime-2.1-Mini
OpenAI-Realtime-2-Mini.description: GPT-Realtime-2.1-Mini (July 6, 2026) — distilled reasoning model for faster, lower-cost realtime voice. First mini Realtime tier with reasoning + tool use / function calling enabled (prior mini lacked reasoning). Audio and text inputs over WebRTC, WebSocket, or SIP. Same price as the previous gpt-realtime-mini: $0.60/M text input, $2.40/M text output, $10/M audio input, $20/M audio output, $0.80/M image input. Significantly improves alphanumeric recognition vs GPT-Realtime-2. Ships at the mini cost envelope while supporting the full voice-agent execution loop — audio in → intent reasoning → tool call → verification → response. Replaces gpt-realtime-mini in the API; backward-compatible model alias.

OpenAI-GPT-Live.name: GPT-Live
OpenAI-GPT-Live.description: OpenAI's full-duplex voice models (launched July 8, 2026): GPT-Live-1 (paid tiers) and GPT-Live-1 mini (free tier default in ChatGPT, replacing Advanced Voice Mode). Full-duplex = speaks and listens simultaneously, allowing natural interruptions and live translation. GPT-Live-1 mini becomes the default voice in ChatGPT across web/iOS/Android; GPT-Live-1 available to Go/Plus/Pro paid users. Routes text queries to GPT-5.5 for search/reasoning/agentic capabilities while maintaining voice conversation. Supports visual output for some responses, longer (30-40 min) hands-free conversations, live translation demoed. Safeguards for age-appropriate responses and self-harm resources. API availability forthcoming (developer signup open). Replaces prior Advanced Voice Mode pipeline that combined STT + LLM + TTS. July 23, 2026 desktop expansion (build 26.715): GPT-Live powers the ChatGPT desktop app on macOS and Windows with global hotkey, Appshots (macOS) for active-window screen context, and multi-folder project support. First time voice activation is built natively into Codex on desktop — orchestrate multi-threaded coding jobs (PR review, debugging, generating unit tests) across Codex and ChatGPT Work with spoken instructions; remote execution via iOS for progress checks and prompt responses. Decoupled architecture: GPT-Live handles the live voice layer and inserts natural verbal acknowledgments, while heavy reasoning/agentic work delegates to GPT-5.5 in the background. Available to Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Education subscribers.

Amazon.name: Amazon Polly
Amazon.description: Managed neural TTS with brand voice and enterprise deployment options.

ElevenLabs.name: ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs.description: High-quality speech synthesis, dubbing, and voice cloning platform. Conversational AI 2.0 (May 2026) with state-of-the-art turn-taking, integrated RAG for knowledge bases, automatic language detection across 70+ languages, multi-character personas, HIPAA compliance, EU data residency, batch outbound calling, voice+text multimodality. Eleven v3 conversational model with audio tags. Dubbing v2 launched May 28, 2026 (re-promoted June 17) — emotion-preserving AI dubbing that conditions directly on the original performance (tone, pacing, delivery, emotional intent) rather than generating flat audio from a transcript alone; 90+ languages, synchronization-aware translation that adjusts phrasing/timing to source-video cadence, automatic voice cloning. Creator Dubbing Partner Program offers discounted access. June 7, 2026: V4 model preview at ElevenSummit Warsaw (Mati Staniszewski) — greater control over voice, emotion, accent, whispering, singing; D2 dubbing model also previewed. ElevenLabs recently surpassed $500M ARR; new investors BlackRock and Nvidia. Ads Engine in ElevenCreative launched June 22, 2026 — connects Google, Meta, and LinkedIn ad accounts; localizes existing ads across 50+ languages and pushes finished creatives back to the ad platform. First 'engine' in ElevenCreative, with more engines teased. The Odyssey audiobook (narrated by Sir Michael Caine's cloned voice with original cinematic music and sound design) launched June 23, 2026 on ElevenReader as a showcase for high-fidelity voice cloning.

PlayHT.name: PlayAI
PlayHT.description: Realtime voice agent and TTS stack built on the PlayHT platform.

Murf.name: Murf AI
Murf.description: Studio-style voice generation for narration, explainers, and enterprise media.

WellSaid.name: WellSaid Labs
WellSaid.description: Enterprise voice generation for training, marketing, and product narration.

Cartesia.name: Cartesia Sonic
Cartesia.description: Real-time voice AI platform from Cartesia built on State Space Models (SSMs) — the only vendor ranked #1 on both TTS and STT streaming benchmarks (June 16, 2026). Sonic-3.5 streaming TTS: 90ms time-to-first-audio, 42 languages, refined prosodic rhythm, natural intonation, superior pacing. Ink-2 streaming STT: 3.6% WER (English), native noise-aware turn-detection that detects end-of-turn from semantic understanding rather than silence duration. Bidirectional streaming designed for real-time voice agents (customer support, phone, conversational AI) — not narrator-grade audiobook use cases. Sub-1.6s final STT latency, $0.43/hr STT pricing. Sonic-3.5 also available standalone as a TTS API. Single unified API for both TTS and STT. Voice agent platform with SIP trunking (beta) for connecting existing phone systems. Competes directly with ElevenLabs v3 (long-form), OpenAI Realtime API (tight LLM integration), and AWS Transcribe + Polly on latency and accuracy for agent workloads.

Vapi.name: Vapi
Vapi.description: Developer platform for production voice AI agents (founded 2024, raised $50M+). Powers 1M+ production voice agents across customer support, sales, scheduling, healthcare. Grok Voice API default (June 3, 2026). Squads v2 multi-assistant orchestration, Composer AI assistant for agent building, Simulations testing harness. Monitoring (April 15, 2026): customizable monitors for effectiveness (intent fulfillment), compliance (prompt constraint adherence), technical (tool/LLM/STT/TTS failures), infrastructure (latency, dropped calls); enterprise tier alerts to ops owners. MCP support with bearer auth, child tool discovery. HIPAA with data retention, Zero Data Retention compliance modes. Vapi MCP server for agent integrations; Vapi MCP Client to consume remote MCPs. Direct SIP trunking, native DTMF, warm transfers with caller ID and variable filling. Compatible with OpenAI Realtime, GPT-5 family, Claude 4.5-4.6, Gemini 3 Flash, Grok 4 Fast, ElevenLabs, Cartesia Sonic-3.5/Ink-2, Deepgram Nova-3, WellSaid, Inworld. Vapi x Deepgram Aura-2 integration. Recent Amazon Ring production deployment.

Mistral.name: Voxtral TTS
Mistral.description: Mistral's state-of-the-art TTS with zero-shot voice cloning, multilingual support (9 languages), real-time streaming.

MiniMax.name: MiniMax Audio
MiniMax.description: MiniMax's TTS platform (Speech 2.8, 2.6, 2.5) with realistic voice cloning across 40+ languages, enhanced multilingual performance, and natural rhythm. HD speech on Token Plan.

Microsoft-MAI-Voice-2-Flash.name: MAI-Voice-2-Flash
Microsoft-MAI-Voice-2-Flash.description: Microsoft's real-time text-to-speech and voice synthesis model, released in public preview July 23, 2026 alongside MAI-Image-2.5-Pro. 2x faster than MAI-Voice-2 and 32% lower cost. 30+ prebuilt voices across 20+ languages with SSML support, low-latency streaming, and emotional tone control. Omilia.name: Lexis
Omilia.description: Omilia's native generative TTS engine for enterprise contact centers (launched July 8, 2026, Athens). Built directly into the Omilia Cloud Platform (OCP) with sub-45ms first-audio latency, audio stays inside the OCP perimeter (no third-party speech, language, or voice services). Short high-quality recording enables a custom branded voice in minutes; two-layer tuning (custom pronunciation dictionaries + SSML at the linguistic layer, warmth/pitch/pace/emotional range at the model layer). 25+ locales with native pronunciation and prosody; pre-tuned 'CX Ambassador' personas (Trusted Advisor, Quick Operator). Compliant with PCI-DSS, SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, CCPA. Available as fully managed SaaS or on-premise deployment for data-residency mandates. Eliminates the third-party audit surface conventional TTS API chains introduce.

SpaceXAI.name: Grok Voice API
SpaceXAI.description: xAI TTS and voice cloning API with Custom Voices (May 2026). grok-voice-think-fast-1.0 for voice agents. $4.20 per 1M characters, Voice Agent $3/hr.

SpaceXAI-Voice-Builder.name: Voice Agent Builder
SpaceXAI-Voice-Builder.description: xAI's no-code platform for production voice agents on Grok Voice (launched July 1, 2026, also integrated as Vapi's default voice provider June 3, 2026). Bundles telephony, knowledge retrieval, tools, guardrails, MCPs, observability in one speech-to-speech interface. 80+ voices plus custom voice cloning. Flat $0.05/min audio, $0.01/min provisioned telephony. 25+ languages, sub-2-min setup. 21 new flagship voices added July 6, 2026. SOC 2, HIPAA eligible, GDPR compliant.

Microsoft.name: MAI-Voice-2
Microsoft.description: Microsoft's MAI-Voice-2 TTS (June 2, 2026, Build 2026) with expressive prosody, voice cloning from 5-60s reference clips, voice prompting, and consent guardrails. Supports 15 languages with more coming. MAI-Voice-2-Flash for latency-sensitive voice agents coming soon. Available via Azure Speech ($22 per 1M characters) and integrated into VS Code and Dynamics 365 Contact Center. DuoAI demo showcases multimodal agent conversations with MAI-Voice-2 + MAI-Transcribe-1.5 + MAI-Image-2.5.

OpenAI-Transcribe.name: GPT-Live-Transcribe (voice input)
OpenAI-Transcribe.description: OpenAI's low-latency streaming transcription model for live voice input (launched July 28, 2026). Pairs with GPT-Realtime-2/2.1 voice agents to deliver continuous transcript deltas from microphone or WebRTC audio. Replaces `gpt-realtime-whisper-1` for live captioning and voice-agent STT. Tunable `delay` parameter trades faster partial transcripts against higher final accuracy; preserves existing `conversation.item.input_audio_transcription.delta` and `.completed` events. Context (free-form `prompt`) and `keywords` hints for domain terms/names carry over from the file model. Hits 9.60% WER on Real-World Audio Recording vs 11.65% for `gpt-realtime-whisper-1`. WebSocket or WebRTC transport preserved. Available alongside GPT-Transcribe (file transcription) under the new transcription pair.

Google.name: Cloud Speech-to-Text
Google.description: Managed transcription and speech understanding APIs on Google Cloud. Now powered by Gemini 3.5 Live Translate for 70+ language translation (June 9, 2026).

OpenAI.name: Audio API
OpenAI.description: Audio stack for transcription, translation, speech generation, and realtime apps. GPT-Realtime-2 for voice reasoning, GPT-Realtime-Whisper for streaming STT, GPT-Realtime-Translate for 70+ language translation (May 7, 2026).

AssemblyAI.description: Developer platform for transcription, speech understanding, and voice apps.

StabilityAI.name: Stable Audio 3.0
StabilityAI.description: Stability AI's audio generation family (May 20, 2026). Small SFX, Small, Medium (1.4B), and Large (2.7B) variants. Generates high-quality musical tracks up to 6 min 20s at 44.1kHz stereo — more than double Stable Audio 2.0. Small and Medium weights open on Hugging Face; Large available via API and self-hosting. Microsoft.name: MAI-Transcribe-1.5

Available via Azure Speech ($0.36/hour) and integrated into Copilot, Teams, GitHub, and Dynamics 365 Contact Center.

ElevenLabs.name: ElevenMusic Mixes
ElevenLabs.description: Personalized weekly generative playlists on ElevenMusic (launched June 18, 2026) — 33 tracks refreshed every Sunday built from your listening history (skips, saves, likes, watch time). Includes AI-generated tracks unique to you: Pro users get 11 generated tracks/week, free users get 5. Sound profile forms after 3+ interactions; hearting tracks tunes future mixes. Available on web and iOS at elevenmusic.io. Complements the ElevenLabs voice platform (Dubbing v2, V4 model preview) and ElevenLabs Avatars. Ads Engine in ElevenCreative launched June 22, 2026 — connects Google, Meta, and LinkedIn ad accounts; localizes existing ads across 50+ languages and pushes finished creatives back to the ad platform. First 'engine' in ElevenCreative, with more engines teased. The Odyssey audiobook (narrated by Sir Michael Caine's cloned voice with original cinematic music and sound design) launched June 23, 2026 on ElevenReader as a showcase for high-fidelity voice cloning.

OpenAI-Transcribe.name: GPT-Transcribe & GPT-Live-Transcribe
OpenAI-Transcribe.description: OpenAI's two new transcription models launched July 28, 2026 to replace Whisper for most production workloads. GPT-Transcribe (`gpt-transcribe`) is optimized for high-accuracy file and committed-turn transcription over `POST /v1/audio/transcriptions` or via Realtime WebSocket sessions; GPT-Live-Transcribe (`gpt-live-transcribe`) is built for low-latency streaming transcripts from continuously arriving microphone audio. Both models accept free-form `prompt` context, `keywords` for domain terms/names, and a `languages` array (replacing the legacy `language` hint) and return detected-language predictions in completed results. On the new Context Aware ASR benchmark, free-form context increased semantic accuracy from 38.5% to 44.6% (Live) and 41.6% to 45.2% (File). On the Real-World Audio Recording benchmark, GPT-Live-Transcribe hit 9.60% WER vs gpt-realtime-whisper-1 at 11.65%; GPT-Transcribe hit 8.98% vs whisper-1 at 15.21%. Live model supports a tunable `delay` setting (low-latency partials vs higher-accuracy finals). Migration cookbook covers Whisper to GPT-Transcribe and gpt-realtime-whisper to GPT-Live-Transcribe; legacy `whisper-1` and `gpt-realtime-whisper-1` remain available for subtitle/VTT/timestamps/translation/diarization use cases where drop-in replacement is not supported. Also routed via OpenRouter unified audio endpoint since launch.

Google.name: NotebookLM
Google.description: Source-grounded research notebook with summaries, audio overviews, and citation workflows. Notebooks in Gemini for project organization. Powered by Gemini 3.5 Flash. Tencent-Hyra.name: Hyra-1.0 (Hunyuan Research Agent)
Tencent-Hyra.description: Tencent Hunyuan's research intelligent agent with recursive self-improvement (released July 21, 2026) for performance-oriented research and engineering tasks. Three-component architecture: Context Agent maintains an experience library and continuously generates 'inspiration' context to fill the task queue; multiple Proposal Agents take context from the queue and generate/run solutions in independent sandboxes; the system operates as an asynchronous producer-consumer pipeline where resource utilization expands efficiently over time. For tasks without an evaluator, Hyra upgrades to a two-layer loop where solutions and evaluation mechanisms evolve together, preventing reward hacking. Follows 'The Bitter Lesson' philosophy — keep the framework lightweight and expand the agent's action space, using a simple general loop to convert intelligence and compute into real returns.
